verdict_text:
YES

The script verifies identical key sets across all three checkpoints and bit-exact equality of every non-MLP tensor before writing anything, selects exactly the 64 MLP tensors via a `fullmatch` regex on the four documented suffixes, computes `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` with λ=0.4 in float32 against the unmodified base (both task vectors use `b` from `base`, so no ordering hazard), casts back to the base dtype, copies all other tensors from base unchanged, asserts `merged == 64` and `len(out) == 244`, and writes a single `out/T4/model.safetensors`.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm).
